title: Checkout failures after deployment v2.4.1
description: Support started getting complaints around 09:20 that customers can't complete checkout - they click Pay and get a spinner, then an error page. We shipped v2.4.1 at 09:12 so that's almost certainly it. Can someone confirm and roll back? Payments team says their side looks fine.

deployment_notes:
v2.4.1 - deployed 2024-03-14 09:12 by CI pipeline #8831
Changes:
  - Add promo-code field to the checkout form (frontend only)
  - Bump analytics SDK 3.1.0 -> 3.2.0
  - Copy change on the confirmation email
No database migrations. No config changes. No connection-pool changes.

Other changes that day (not part of v2.4.1):
  - 08:40  Data team enabled the new hourly `orders_daily_rollup` batch job
           in the reporting service. Runs against db-primary, not the replica.
           Ticket DATA-771. Not reviewed by the platform team.
  - 07:30  Routine certificate rotation on the payments gateway. Completed OK.
